clue.text: Specially order running water from doorman

parts.note: to commission something is to order it made specially
the Aire is a river in Yorkshire, i.e. running water

explanation.surface: Someone places a special order for tap water with the hotel porter.
explanation.walkthrough: The AIRE is a river in Yorkshire, northern England. A commissionaire is a uniformed doorman at a hotel or cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: A uniformed attendant who stands at the entrance of a hotel or theatre is called this.

clue.text: For a gold piece, I do more work

indicators.note: work as a verb means to knead or rework the letters of I do more into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone promises to put in extra effort in exchange for a gold coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' rearranges IDOMORE. A moidore was an old Portuguese gold coin, once current in England.
explanation.definitionFit: The moidore was a Portuguese coin struck in gold, circulating in the 18th century.

clue.text: As roads may dangerously be, around December lst?

definitions.text: As roads may dangerously be, around December lst?

parts.words: As roads may dangerously be, around December lst
parts.note: a description of winter road conditions at the start of December, when frost makes them slippery

explanation.surface: A warning about hazardous road conditions at the start of winter.
explanation.definitionFit: Roads covered in frozen water are treacherous, a typical early-winter hazard.

clue.text: Checks collection, and puts money on

parts.note: a set is a collection of things belonging together
to back a horse is to bet money on it

explanation.surface: Someone checks the collection plate and then has a flutter on the horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverses or hindrances that hold progress back are checks.

clue.text: Be against work with model

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to pose is to sit as a model for an artist

explanation.surface: Someone objects to working alongside a fashion model.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist or object to something is to stand against it.

clue.text: Vital loans taken out by footballers

indicators.note: taken out suggests letters pulled apart and rearranged, so vital loans is reshuffled

explanation.surface: Footballers take out essential loans to stay afloat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken out' rearranges VITALLOANS. Aston Villa is a Birmingham football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Aston Villa is an English football club, so its players are footballers.

clue.text: Curious staff seen in fictional chambers

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or curious
a pole is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: An odd walking stick turns up in some fictional bedroom.
explanation.walkthrough: Rumpole of the Bailey is a British TV and book series about a barrister; barristers work from offices called chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: Horace Rumpole is the invented barrister whose legal practice is based in London barristers' chambers.

clue.text: Vendor that automatically coins it in

definitions.text: Vendor that automatically coins it in

parts.words: Vendor that automatically coins it in
parts.note: a machine that sells goods on its own when coins are inserted, and makes money for its owner

explanation.surface: A self-service seller who rakes in cash without effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin-operated vending or gambling device takes money automatically through its slot.

clue.text: Have a high old time?

parts.note: an invitation to party and enjoy oneself extravagantly

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to enjoy oneself lavishly, like having a grand celebration.

clue.text: Indian beginning to mow through the weaker batsmen

indicators.note: through means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: in cricket the tail is the weaker batsmen who bat last

indicators.note: beginning to mow means just the first letter of mow

explanation.surface: A cricket report of a bowler from India mowing down the lower order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to' takes M from mow; 'through' puts it inside TAIL. In cricket the tail is the low-order batsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamil is a people and language of southern India and Sri Lanka.

clue.text: Terrier sailor's given to prime minister

parts.note: a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor
Lord John Russell was a British prime minister in the 19th century

explanation.surface: A sailor's dog is handed over to the prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord John Russell was twice British prime minister in the 1840s and 1860s.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jack Russell is a small breed of hunting dog of the terrier type.

clue.text: Only give a couple of seconds to good book

parts.note: two words for a second: mo is a short moment and s abbreviates second
two words for a second: mo is a short moment and s abbreviates second

explanation.surface: Someone spares only a moment to read the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'good book' is the Bible; Amos is one of its books.
explanation.definitionFit: Amos is a prophetic book of the Old Testament, part of the Bible.

clue.text: Fainting at this Sandhurst parade?

explanation.surface: A cadet keels over during the graduation parade at the military academy.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandhurst is Britain's officer training academy; cadets finish their training with a ceremonial parade.
explanation.definitionFit: Losing consciousness is one sense; the other is the graduation parade marking completion of officer training.

clue.text: Tabloid's star columnist

parts.note: reads as a newspaper's celebrated writer, but means the writer of the horoscope column about stars

explanation.definitionFit: The person who writes the daily horoscopes reads the stars for the paper.

clue.text: Put by Oriental wine as memento

parts.note: to put by is to keep or save
sake is Japanese rice wine

explanation.surface: A bottle of Japanese wine is set aside as a souvenir.
explanation.definitionFit: A souvenir kept to remember someone or something is a memento.

clue.text: Came in to organise show-house

indicators.note: organise signals that the letters of came in are arranged anew

explanation.surface: Someone arrived to arrange a display home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to organise' rearranges CAMEIN. 'show-house' is read as a house of shows.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture house where films are screened is a house for shows.

clue.text: About to run away to the point

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to levant is old slang for absconding, especially to dodge a debt

explanation.surface: Someone is about to flee to a particular spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pertinent or bearing on the matter is to the point.

clue.text: He's frequently called over in the game

definitions.text: He's frequently called over in the game

parts.words: He's frequently called over in the game
parts.note: seems to be a player summoned often, but in cricket this official calls 'over' after every six balls

explanation.definitionFit: The cricket official calls 'over' at the end of each set of six deliveries and is often appealed to.

clue.text: Divine decree introduced by priest briefly

indicators.note: introduced by means the other piece comes before it

parts.note: Pr is an abbreviation of priest
an edict is a decree

explanation.surface: A holy decree is announced by a cleric in a few words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Divine' looks like an adjective meaning holy, but it is a verb here, meaning to foretell; 'introduced by' says the priest's abbreviation comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To divine is to foresee or foretell what will happen.

clue.text: Put one's foot down, getting out of engagement

definitions.text: Put one's foot down, getting out of engagement

parts.words: Put one's foot down, getting out of engagement
parts.note: sounds like breaking off a betrothal firmly, but describes pressing a car pedal to disengage the gears

explanation.definitionFit: A driver presses the pedal to release the clutch and disengage the gears.

clue.text: Journey to oil-processing port

parts.note: a trip is a journey

indicators.note: processing treats the letters of oil, rearranging them

explanation.surface: A voyage to a refinery harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'processing' rearranges OIL into OLI. Tripoli is the capital and port of Libya.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is a harbour city on the Mediterranean coast of Libya.

clue.text: Stabbed king-fined, beaten up

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: beaten up signals that the letters of fined are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A king, already fined, is attacked and stabbed.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen in 'king-fined' is surface glue only; 'beaten up' scrambles the second half, which follows the king's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To be attacked with a blade means to be stabbed.

clue.text: Aspersions engulf the wrong islander

indicators.note: engulf means one piece swallows the other

parts.note: slander is damaging aspersions

indicators.note: wrong signals that the letters of the are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Slurs overwhelm an innocent island resident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' scrambles the three-letter word; 'engulf' sets it inside the aspersions. Shetland is a group of Scottish islands north of the mainland.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Shetland Isles off Scotland is an islander.

clue.text: Indicate to write one's name

explanation.definitionFit: To signal or gesture is one sense; the other is to put a signature on a document.

clue.text: Quiz in chemistry includes this element

indicators.note: includes signals that the answer lies within the run of letters of quiz in chemistry

explanation.surface: A chemistry test features a question on this element.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinc is a metallic chemical element, number 30 in the periodic table.

clue.text: Prone to telling fibs?

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is lying flat face down; the other is speaking untruths.

clue.text: Dull club used once for evening work

parts.note: flat means dull or lifeless
an iron is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A boring golf club once used for nighttime jobs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evening' means making even, smoothing creases, not nighttime. A flatiron was an old iron heated on a stove.
explanation.definitionFit: Before electric ones, a heated metal block was used to press clothes smooth.

clue.text: Offender that's shopped, taken by him?

definitions.text: Offender that's shopped, taken by him?

parts.words: Offender that's shopped, taken by him
parts.note: a criminal who is shopped, i.e. betrayed, also one caught shoplifting in a shop and taken in by staff

explanation.definitionFit: A plain-clothes guard in a department store catches shoplifters.
